$note: Architect profile for SageThumbs 2K. Run from the Connections checkout: $env:ARCHITECT_NO_SELF_UPDATE='1'; bun <Connections>/packages/connections-arkitect/bin/arkitect.mjs --root . --all (or npx -y connections-arkitect). native-toolchain-gates executes THIS repo's own declared gates (cargo fmt --check, cargo deny check; clippy opt-in via runHeavyGates) and BLOCKS on their failure.
$suite: THE ROSTER THAT FITS THIS REPOSITORY (2026-09-24). A --all run used to execute the whole Architect core here, and a Rust app answered 'no CDK app, no migrations directory, no Lambda handler tree' to dozens of checks forever. The roster is now the portable profile plus the core checks configured under `checks` below, each one a check whose subject this repository really has. Add a core check by configuring it under `checks`; never by disabling others.

update.$reason: Runs against the Connections dev checkout's core; self-update from a dev checkout must never rewrite the core's source of truth.

scan.$reason: MEASURE THE REPOSITORY, NOT THE WORKING FOLDER (2026-09-14). The walk is a filesystem walk, so it read four directories that are not this codebase and inflated every count with them: a stale duplicate of the website (the real one is the sibling site repo, and this copy is hidden by .git/info/exclude), a gitignored payload folder, and the two scratch outputs. Measured on the 2026-09-09 run: 339 of the 3,303 finding paths, including every one of the maintainability check's 0.0-scoring files and 276 clone sites. Excluding them is a correction to the measurement, not a way to hide a finding - nothing here is shipped, tracked, or reviewable.
scan.$vendored-file: src/bin/app/nudge_engine.rs is a line-for-line port of Connections' src/nudge.ts, kept in lockstep with that spec by rule (never restructured here; a drift shows as a failing test on one side), so its size and shape are the spec's - the same standing as crates/vendor. The exclusion registry matches a file path exactly as it matches a directory prefix, so it lists here (2026-09-19).

churn-hotspots.$reason: Measures git churn against the Rust and Python source this repository has.

python-swallowed-exception.$reason: The repository carries Python (62 .py files under scripts and tooling).

source-language-coverage.$reason: Reports which of this repository's languages the Architect can read - the question a foreign repository most needs answered.

dependency-currency.$reason: Reads Cargo.lock against the crates.io index (read-only).

checks.$dup-note: NO RATCHET IS AVAILABLE for code-duplication-core: its ceiling key belongs to the Connections-only `code-duplication` sibling, and this check never gates by design. The Architect's own check-config-key-consumed caught the attempt (2026-09-14) - left recorded here so nobody re-adds a key that does nothing.

maintainability-index.$reason: Same ratchet. Both counts are the measured state with the scratch directories excluded; the production one is what matters, and it must not grow.
